decided: Sherozbek, 11 Nov 2026 (VARIABLES.md B38): the use table covers every variable, in three categories (terrain, thermal, composition), and each site says where the analog succeeds, where it fails, and where Earth's limits are. Drafted by Claude on his instruction; he reviews the wording.
what_it_is: A fixed table, written by hand before any result exists. The engine reads it and never writes a sentence of its own. No language model produces text at run time.
scale_warning: Every variable describes ground at the scale of one cell, about 6 to 7 km across. None of them describes boulders, soil grains or anything a wheel touches. The sentences below are about kilometre-scale terrain, cell-average temperature and bulk rock type, and say so.
how_a_site_gets_its_lines: For each row, look at the verdicts of its variables for this site (agrees / partial / differs, from the position gap).
If a variable of the row is in run.ranking.out_of_range for this target, the row goes to BEYOND EARTH with if_beyond_earth. This holds in both ranking systems.
Otherwise, if every variable of the row agrees, the row goes to SUCCEEDS with if_agrees.
Otherwise, if any variable of the row differs, the row goes to FAILS with if_differs.
Otherwise (partial, or no data) the row is not listed.
If SUCCEEDS is empty, print general_sentence.
general_sentence: No variable agrees closely enough to name a use. The site is the nearest Earth has, not a stand-in for the target.

rows.label: Slope
rows.if_agrees: Gradients are like the target's: use the site for rover and crew mobility, traverse energy budgets and landing-slope checks.
rows.if_differs: Gradients are different: mobility and landing-slope results from this site do not transfer.
rows.if_beyond_earth: No ground on Earth has the target's gradients at this scale.

rows.label: Relief over 5 to 10 km
rows.if_agrees: Local relief is like the target's: plan and rehearse short traverses and descent paths over the same ups and downs.
rows.if_differs: Local relief is different: short-traverse and descent planning from this site does not transfer.
rows.if_beyond_earth: Earth has no ground with the target's local relief.

rows.label: Relief over 21 to 42 km
rows.if_agrees: Regional relief is like the target's: rehearse long traverses and line-of-sight communication across the same scale of hills and basins.
rows.if_differs: Regional relief is different: long-range route and communication planning from this site does not transfer.
rows.if_beyond_earth: Earth has no ground with the target's regional relief.

rows.label: Landform position (bowl or ridge)
rows.if_agrees: The site sits in the same kind of landform as the target (basin floor, slope or ridge): access routes and what can be seen from the ground behave alike.
rows.if_differs: The site sits in a different landform (a bowl against a ridge, or the reverse): access and visibility lessons do not transfer.
rows.if_beyond_earth: Earth has no landform as deep or as high above its surroundings as the target.

rows.label: Open sky
rows.if_agrees: The same share of the sky is open: rehearse solar-power siting and antenna pointing under the same horizon.
rows.if_differs: The horizon blocks a different share of the sky: solar and communication planning from this site does not transfer.
rows.if_beyond_earth: No place on Earth is as enclosed, or as open, as the target.

rows.label: Temperature level
rows.if_agrees: The average surface temperature is like the target's: run hardware and people at the temperature they will meet.
rows.if_differs: The average surface temperature is different: thermal-design results from this site do not transfer.
rows.if_beyond_earth: No ground on Earth is this cold. Tests at the target's temperature need a chamber, not a field site.

rows.label: Day-night swing
rows.if_agrees: The surface swings between day and night as the target does: use the site for thermal-cycling tests of hardware.
rows.if_differs: The day-night swing is different: thermal-cycling results from this site do not transfer.
rows.if_beyond_earth: No ground on Earth swings this far between day and night. Earth's air and oceans damp it.

rows.label: Seasonal swing (Mars only)
rows.if_agrees: The surface swings through the year as the target does: plan long stays and overwintering here.
rows.if_differs: The seasonal swing is different: long-stay planning from this site does not transfer.
rows.if_beyond_earth: No ground on Earth swings this far through the year.

rows.label: Silica (rock type)
rows.if_agrees: The rock is of the same bulk type as the target's (basalt-like or silica-rich): practise sampling, drilling and contact instruments on it. Composition is a weak variable; check the site's rock in the field.
rows.if_differs: The rock is of a different bulk type: sampling and drilling results from this site do not transfer.
rows.if_beyond_earth: Earth's mapped rock classes do not reach the target's silica content.

rows.label: Iron oxide
rows.if_agrees: The ground is as iron-rich as the target's: practise spectrometer and resource-prospecting work on it. Composition is a weak variable; check the site's rock in the field.
rows.if_differs: The iron content is different: spectral and prospecting results from this site do not transfer.
rows.if_beyond_earth: Earth's mapped rock classes do not reach the target's iron content.
